A Smashing Start - You lured Flossy to her death and collected the souvenir
Have a Nice Day! - As the mouse, beat the dog in a race and collect the souvenir
Honeymoon Lagoon - Use a sheep to float through all the rings and collect the souvenir
The Battery Farm - Kill all the sheep and collect the souvenir
The Engine Room - Destroy all the machines and collect the souvenir
Fat Bear Mountain - Activate all three switches and collect the souvenir
Rocky Hard Place - Elevate the asteroid chunks and collect the souvenir
Stinky Sewers - Eat all the rotten meat as the rat and collect the souvenir
Rat-o-Matic - Destroy the gas containers and collect the souvenir
Snow Joke - Turn off the light and collect the souvenir
Ice n' Easy, Does it? - Kill all the walruses with a heli-rabbit and collect the souvenir
Penguin Playpen - Kill all the cool cods, then collect the souvenir
Pinball Blizzard - Get the penguins to sing, then collect the souvenir
Hoppa Choppa - Kill all the rabbits near the exit and collect the souvenir
Something Fishy - Race through the blue rings and collect the souvenir
Jungle Japes - Put the rocks in the slots and collect the souvenir
Jungle Doldrums - Reach new heights and collect the souvenir
Swamp of Eternal Stench - Put yourself behind bars and collect the souvenir
Weight For It! - Throw all the boulders at the red rings and collect the souvenir
Jungle Jumps - Race through the blue rings and collect the souvenir
Fun in the Sun - Kill all the Armed Desert Foxes with an Armed Desert Fox and collect the souvenir
Hot Cross Buns - Throw the dead scorpions into the black whirlpool and collect the souvenir
Sting in the Tail - Kill all the scorpions and collect the souvenir
Borassic Park - Destroy the dinosaur skull's teeth and collect the souvenir
Whirlwind Tour - Destroy all three scorpions and collect the souvenir
Shifting Sands - Enter the tent and collect the souvenir.
